description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two performance metrics on dual y-axes: “Perplexity” (left, linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7) and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” (right, linear scale from 40 to 100). Four distinct lines are plotted: “Perplexity” (orange, solid line with circle markers) starts at ~4.6 at 10% sequence ratio, drops to ~4.3 at 40%, fluctuates slightly between 4.3 and 4.35 up to 80%, then rises to ~4.4 at 100%. “Full Cache PPL” (red, dashed horizontal line) remains constant at ~4.38 across all sequence ratios. “GPU Mem. Ratio” (blue, solid line with circle markers) begins at ~42% at 10%, increases gradually to ~55% at 80%, then sharply jumps to ~100% at 100%. “Full Cache GPU Mem.” (blue, dashed horizontal line) is fixed at ~60% across the entire x-axis range. The plot demonstrates how varying the recent sequence ratio affects model perplexity and GPU memory usage relative to full-cache baselines.
